our_interpretation: The firm assertion concerns the difficulty of extending reliable detection beyond familiar characters. The easy-case statement is a concession, not a firm prediction.
In context, the plain reading concerns recognizing copyrighted visual material and its sources, rather than making a legal determination of infringement.
I interpret the ongoing observation as describing January 2024 capabilities up to the post date. This is an evaluation period, not a company reporting period.
Getting it right means detecting less familiar works reliably while avoiding substantial false positives. Marcus supplies no numerical accuracy threshold.
